test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error’.

Using a loofah with a hydrating / shower gel each day also ensures / you'll have the most smoothest skin.

options.text: shower gel each day also ensures
you'll have the most smoothest skin.
Using a loofah with a hydrating

solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 3 i.e. (you'll have the most smoothest skin.)'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in this sentence is the double superlative "most smoothest". 
 
• In English, we don't use 'most' with '-est' forms. The word should be either 'smoothest' or 'most smooth', not both.
 
• Therefore, the sentence should read, 'Using a loofah with a hydrating/shower gel each day also ensures you'll have the smoothest skin.'
 
• Thus, Option 3 (you'll have the most smoothest skin.) represents the part of the sentence with the error.

Therefore, the correct sentence is: 'Using a loofah with a hydrating/shower gel each day also ensures you'll have the smoothest skin.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Using a loofah with a hydrating" - This phrase is grammatically correct.
 
• "shower gel each day also ensures" - This is also a correctly formed part of the sentence.
